old_description: Beautiful shows, always one of my favorite ones to do. I always get the responses that I need
about:
The Peterson Company operates from Auburn, Washington, with a second production facility in Moonachie, New Jersey. The business, also known as Peterson Foods, has built a reputation as a specialty food supplier and value-added processor for the Pacific Northwest and beyond. No founding year or ownership details are publicly stated.

The company maintains a broad catalog of domestic and imported artisan cheeses, charcuterie, bakery items, and specialty ingredients, available through a 24/7 online ordering system. Its core manufacturing service is custom cutting and packing: two third-party-audited facilities provide hand wrapping, shrink wrapping, cryovac vacuum packaging, cheese cubing, portioning into cups or bags, variety tray and gift box assembly, and custom labeling. The same lines also handle chocolate, candies, and nuts.

Customers include independent restaurants, hotel kitchens, specialty retailers, and pastry chefs such as the one at Seattle’s Ray’s Boathouse who has sourced from Peterson for 25 years. Buyers cite the one-stop-shop inventory, free delivery, and responsive customer service as reasons they consolidate purchasing through the company.

Peterson positions its cutting and packing service as a way for clients to eliminate in-house labor, trim loss, and liability while preserving freshness and upscale presentation. The monthly Provisions Flyer highlights seasonal items across cheese, charcuterie, bakery, and ingredient categories.

name: The Sam Tell Companies
old_description: An award-winning kitchen design team, highly skilled equipment installers, and restaurant smallwares experts all under one roof
about:
The Sam Tell Companies traces its roots to 1956, when Sam Tell and his son Neil opened a two-person operation on Bleecker Street in New York City. The family-owned dealership began with a focus on dependable foodservice solutions, and by the 1980s the founder's grandson Marc Tell had joined the business alongside Dan Saltzman. Today Marc serves as chief executive, a team of 180 from two Long Island warehouses and a Manhattan design showroom.

The company operates as a full-service foodservice equipment and supplies dealer, offering design, build, and supply capabilities under one roof. Its award-winning design team creates commercial kitchen layouts, while skilled installers handle equipment placement and project execution. The supply division stocks tens of thousands of products ranging from smallwares to heavy equipment, and the firm provides shipping and delivery across the tri-state area and nationwide. Sam Tell ranks as the 30th largest foodservice equipment and supplies distributor in the United States.

Clients span restaurants and bars, sports and entertainment venues, hospitality, corporate dining, healthcare, education, country clubs, retail, and airport and travel lounges. Notable projects include the kitchen at Lure Fishbar, where chef Josh Capon credited Sam Tell with building the "heart and soul" of the operation.

The company emphasizes what it calls the "Sam Tell Difference": proactive customer service backed by a century of combined experience, tailored attention for each unique operation, and a culture that hires only passionate industry professionals. Those principles echo the founding values of dependability, integrity, and honesty that guided the original father-and-son team.

name: The Status Gruppe, Inc.
old_description: We are currently experiencing extended lead times on Our CSL Bumpers, CSL Bumper race lips, and HRTG Carbon Fiber Lower Lips.
about:
Status Gruppe was founded in 2012 in Hampstead, New Hampshire, by Alpenwerk Performance Group, Inc., doing business as Status Gruppe. The company began from a realization that the aftermarket parts industry lacked a combination of quality and affordability, prompting the founders to develop parts that enthusiasts want at prices they are willing to pay.

Status Gruppe designs and sources a range of performance and styling components for BMW M models, including the F80/F82/F83 and G80/G82/G83 generations as well as the E46 M3. The product line covers exhaust systems, downpipes, carbon-fiber exterior parts (grilles, splitters, diffusers, trunk lids), suspension coilovers, forced-induction hardware, and drivetrain accessories. The company collaborates with external manufacturers to produce its designs and maintains inventory for fast shipping on stocked items.

The company serves the automotive aftermarket, targeting BMW enthusiasts and track-car builders. Its customers include individual owners of F8X and G8X M3/M4 models, E46 M3 owners, and shops looking for bolt-on performance upgrades. Testimonials on the site reference an E36 M3 track car fitted with an SRS coilover kit, an E46 M3 equipped with an SCZA exhaust system, and an E46 M3 with a carbon-fiber front spoiler.

Status Gruppe positions itself on delivering quality parts at affordable prices by closely monitoring its target markets and developing products that meet enthusiast demand at competitive price points.

name: The Sublimation Station Inc.
old_description: Experience the difference of full-dye sublimation. Lighter weight, breathable, and vibrant forever.
about:
The Sublimation Station Inc. operates from Orlando, Florida, where it began as a print shop driven by a vision to be different. The founders, inspired by the city’s diverse culture of art, innovation, and creativity, set out to build a vertically integrated operation that would not be “anything less” than the creative energy around them.

The company produces custom dye-sublimation merchandise including all-over-print apparel (t‑shirts, hoodies, sportswear), blankets, accessories, and home‑goods. Its in‑house process covers printing on advanced printheads running over 2,500 sq ft/hr, calendar and flat‑bed heat presses, a 150 W laser cutter with camera registration, serger and coverstitch sewing, and finishing options such as hem tags and branded neck labels. The facility stocks more than 10,000 yards of fabric and has same‑day access to a major wholesale supplier, enabling a print‑on‑demand model with no minimum order quantity on sportswear.

Customers range from individual creators to brands and teams seeking custom merchandise, apparel, youth items, accessories, home‑and‑living products, and team sportswear. The Station also provides fulfillment and drop‑shipping so clients can focus on sales and marketing.

The business emphasizes sustainability through its print‑on‑demand approach, which reduces waste by producing only what is ordered, and by sourcing organic fabrics, recycled materials, and non‑toxic inks. Energy‑efficient equipment further lowers the carbon footprint. Direct‑to‑film printing, unlimited personalization, and rush‑order service round out the offering.

name: The Vault Clothing Co. (Formerly Tickled Pink Boutique)
The Ville Branding
old_description: Exciting items that vary each day! Come back and discover our latest featured selections!
about:
The Ville Branding operates from Nashville, Tennessee, as a promotional products distributor serving businesses nationwide. The company was founded by Jason, who serves as the primary contact, though the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed. The business began with a focus on simplifying the search for promotional merchandise, positioning itself as a personal consultant for brands navigating thousands of product options.

The company sources and customizes a broad range of promotional items including bags, drinkware, apparel, headwear, technology accessories, health products, awards, writing instruments, signage, office supplies, and corporate apparel. It offers custom imprinting services—such as one-color logo application on stainless steel tumblers—and large-format printing capabilities. The operation runs a daily "Product of the Day" feature highlighting specific items like a wine tumbler gift set, but facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not disclosed.

Clients span general businesses, schools, sports teams, and organizations across the United States, with particular activity in trade-show and event marketing. The company cites industry statistics—such as bags generating 1,940 impressions over their lifetime and headwear generating 3,380—to underscore the value of promotional giveaways for brand awareness.

The Ville Branding emphasizes its role as a promotional gear consultant, promising unique, innovative products that elevate brand visibility. Its stated mission is to make clients' names stand out through quality gear that recipients actually keep and use, turning employees and customers into brand ambassadors.

name: The Wood Mill
old_description: Custom Kitchens, Bathroom Vanities, Built-Ins, and More Built Right Here on the Mississippi Gulf Coast.
about:
The Wood Mill operates from Waveland, Mississippi, on the Gulf Coast. The company has served the region for more than 20 years, building custom cabinetry in its own workshop.

The shop produces custom kitchens, bathroom vanities, built-ins, entertainment centers, closets, custom shutters, doors, and one-off furniture pieces. Every cabinet is fabricated on-site, and the team handles design, finishing, and assembly. The company also offers installation across Mississippi, Alabama, and Louisiana, and ships finished pieces throughout the continental United States.

Customers include homeowners, interior decorators, and general contractors throughout the three-state area, as well as commercial clients outfitting offices and business spaces. Projects range from indoor and outdoor kitchens to bathroom remodels and custom storage solutions.

The Wood Mill emphasizes quality, affordability, and professionalism, with a focus on timely delivery and personalized design for each project. The business was built on the premise that locally made, custom cabinetry should be accessible without sacrificing craftsmanship.

name: Thread Your Logo
old_description: Invigorate your branding with products that promote fitness and a healthy lifestyle.
about:
Thread Your Logo operates from Clarksville, Maryland, providing nationwide custom apparel and decoration services. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm specializes in embroidery, screen printing, direct-to-film (DTF) transfers, heat transfer, and sublimation, offering custom manufacturing and company store programs. It handles uniform programs, bags, drinkware, office and technology accessories, and luxury athletic apparel from brands such as Adidas, Nike, and Under Armour. The company services clients across all 50 states.

Its customer base spans healthcare (MedStar, Kaiser Permanente, Johns Hopkins), education (Carnegie Mellon, Georgetown, Howard University), corporate (Amazon, Citibank, Oracle, State Farm, Target, UPS), non-profit (Jack & Jill, New York Restoration Project), military (Military Bowl), hospitality (Royal Sonesta), government (M-NCPPC), and fitness (Yoga Alliance).

Thread Your Logo emphasizes fast turnaround, competitive pricing, free design assistance and mockups, and a 24-hour quote process, positioning itself as a bulk-order specialist that takes pride in every garment processed through its facility.
